instructions_to_main_agent: 1. INSTALL FONTS: Add '@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400&family=Manrope:wght@300;400;500;600&family=Playfair+Display:wght@400;600&display=swap');' to index.css immediately.
2. TAILWIND CONFIG: Update tailwind.config.js to include the custom colors (gold, obsidian) and font families defined above.
3. NO ROUNDED CORNERS: This brand is 'Sharp'. Use 'rounded-none' or 'rounded-sm' max. No 'rounded-xl'.
4. DARK MODE ONLY: Force dark mode. Do not implement a light mode toggle. The brand is exclusively dark.
5. USE SHADCN: Use the existing shadcn components but override their styles using the 'components' classes defined above.
6. PRIVACY FIRST: Every sensitive data point (earnings, messages) should have a 'blur' toggle or mask by default.
7. ANIMATION: Use 'framer-motion' for smooth fade-ins. No bouncy animations. Only ease-out-expo.
universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for text.
Do not use 'Inter' font for headings.
Ensure all text has sufficient contrast (WCAG AA) against the dark background.
